findings.issue: When sync() restores a stored non-default sort on a URL without `sort`, sortedUrl() also removes `page`, so a bookmarked /?page=3 opens page 1.
On a first load without `sort` and a stored non-default sort, location.replace loads the catalog a second time; the default order shows briefly before the sorted one.
data-sort-name/data-sort-price attributes are no longer read by any script (dead markup).
